_activity: Build it: name it, quote it, use it
_licence: ORIGINAL, built on the 11.2 casefile documents (numbered per the signed 11.2 map). Quotes are the casefile's adapted text.
intro: Build the sentence. Drag the correct piece into each blank.

tiles.text: We are fast heading toward anarchy and confusion
each state shall have one vote
leaders feared the government under the Articles was failing
the Constitution had already been ratified

correct_sentence: Document 12 says “We are fast heading toward anarchy and confusion,” which shows leaders feared the government under the Articles was failing.
rationale: Washington's 1786 letter is Document 12. The wrong quotes are real, but they come from Documents 10 and 11.
hints: Washington's letter to Madison is which document?
Which quote is Washington's, and what does it show about the Articles?
